readme_summary: The `rust-toolchain.toml` file pins a specific rust version and ensures that cargo commands run with that version. Note that cargo will automatically install the correct version if it is not already installed. On Linux systems you may need to install libssl-dev, pkg-config, zlib1g-dev, protobuf etc. > [!NOTE] > Note that this builds a debug version that is **not suitable for running a testnet or mainnet validator**. Please read the install guide for instructions to build a release version for test and production uses. XDP transmit is enabled on Linux by default and requires extra capabilities.
